title: sail verdict finds the commons copy of a validate berth recorded on Windows
intention: sail.py verdict finds a validate berth's commons copy by the berth's own file name, whichever box recorded the path, so a ticket charted on akiendell is verdicted on Linux.
why: Measured 2026-11-19 on akiendelllinux: a4892e762b70's chart_claim.validate_berth is C:\Users\akien\.cairn\devices\chart\0\packets\validate-20261113T005908-be563e43b341.json. validate_path returned None although CairnCommons/berths/chart/validate-20261113T005908-be563e43b341.json exists, because posix Path(ref).name of a backslash path is the whole string. Its verdict could not be drafted, and PROVED refused on proved_answers_the_chart.
traces_to: Law 3 and Law 8: a verdict is a measurement, and a ticket built on another box must be measurable here. d86b4e5ae614 (the commons fallback) is the design this completes.
how: In cairn/devices/cc/scripts/sail.py validate_path, take the copy's name as PureWindowsPath(str(ref)).name, which splits on both '\' and '/'. One new tooth after d86b's in cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_sail_queues_the_ticket_at_codemothers_gates.py, keyed PROVES '1e99a571dd6d' clauses 1-2.
